HRA Analysis: DESIRING DIAMONDS (2) looks well handicapped in this race starting off just 10 metres having not been beaten too far in her latest start behind Raffie Jay in the Springboard Final. She has trialled well ahead of her return and should be hard to beat. ICONIC IMAGE (5) faces a big handicap in this race but does have the advantage over one of his key rivals inFREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (6). He sat behind the leader and wasn’t beaten far by Raffie Jay. FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (6) put in a big run two starts ago when finishing second to Raffie Jay after sitting without cover. He faces a big handicap in this race but he is the class runner and with a safe beginning he should be right in the finish again. NONIS GOLD CLASS (3) was able to lead and control things last time out holding off the late challenge of Natty Pagger. She should settle close and can be running on into the money late. SELECTIONS: DESIRING DIAMONDS (2), ICONIC IMAGE (5), FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (6), NONIS GOLD CLASS (3) SUGGESTED BET: DESIRING DIAMONDS (2) to win.

MISS MONEY PENNY (3) showed speed early in a recent trial before being crossed and was running through the nicely late in behind Scar Struck who has shown good ability. She is well bred and should run a good race on debut. UNCLE NOLAN (4) started a short price favourite last time out and had little luck there when back in the field and forced to make a wide run into it finishing fourth. He had run well his start prior and should run well again in this race. BROADWAYBEAUTY (1) led last time out at Redcliffe and was run down late by Jovial Jim and Disembark when finishing third. She draws well again in this race and should be thereabouts again. LAY IT DOWN LOU (2) led a recent trial and was run down late by Charmed Conquest. He draws well in this race and should settle close in the run which should see him dangerous late. SELECTIONS: MISS MONEY PENNY (3), UNCLE NOLAN (4), BROADWAYBEAUTY (1), LAY IT DOWN LOU (2) SUGGESTED BET: MISS MONEY PENNY (3) to win.

SECOND TO NUN (7) scored a good win two starts ago leading all the way to beat Serena Love. She took on a stronger race last time out at Marburg and didn’t have much luck there locking wheels at a crucial stage. FENOMENAL (8) started off 40 metres last time out when running a good fourth not beaten far by Nonis Gold Class. He is much more favourably handicapped in this race and should be hard to beat. NATTY PAGGER (4) impressed two starts ago when not beaten far by Nonis Gold Class at this track. He generally begins well from the stand start and can look to step quickly and attempt to hold the advantage on key rivals which are off bigger handicaps in this race. VOLTAIN (2) was well beaten first up last time out when likely unsuited sitting without cover at Marburg. She is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing and can bounce back in this race. SELECTIONS: SECOND TO NUN (7), FENOMENAL (8), NATTY PAGGER (4), VOLTAIN (2) SUGGESTED BET: NATTY PAGGER (4) to win.

SINABUN (5) won a recent trial in preparation for his return to the races rating fast time at Albion Park. He has good gate speed and may look to launch to the front at the start. If he is able to lead he should prove hard to run down. OUR ROCKY (7) showed very good gate speed when able to lead last time out and was just beaten by a smart one in Always B Cool. He draws wide on the front row but does seem to have excellent gate speed and should settle close enough in the run. CHARGE AHEAD (2) showed gate speed last time out before obtaining the 1-1 trail and just wasn’t quite able to run into the placings late. He draws well to settle close enough in the run and shouldn’t be too far away. DRAGON (6) was running on strongly late last time out behind stablemate Greased Lightnin into second. He draws awkwardly in this race but is racing well and with the right run into the race can figure. SELECTIONS: SINABUN (5), OUR ROCKY (7), CHARGE AHEAD (2), DRAGON (6) SUGGESTED BET: SINABUN (5) to win.

SQUAMISH (3) was able to lead last time out taking them all the way over the 1660 rating good time. He should be able to find a prominent position again from a good draw and looks hard to beat. LEAF STRIDE (10) was very impressive last time out when running on strongly into second behind SQUAMISH (3). He likely derived good benefit from that first outing in QLD and should run well again second up. LOVE GUN (9) didn’t have much luck in his latest outing when checked in a race taken out by Pinnie. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running into it late. LAYDOWNLUNA (4) continued her good run of form last time out when breaking through for another win at Marburg stepping well and leading. She should settle close again and can be running into the money late. SELECTIONS: SQUAMISH (3), LEAF STRIDE (10), LOVE GUN (9), LAYDOWNLUNA (4) SUGGESTED BET: SQUAMISH (3) to win.

RACANA (4) looked quite unlucky two starts ago when taken on out in front over the 2138 and was just run down late by NEXT TO ME (6) who had a much more favourable run off the speed in that race. If she can lead and get things on her terms she is likely to take plenty of running down. COSMIC FLYER (7) is a standout on class in this race and was a good winner three starts ago finishing off strongly to get over the top at this track and trip in a truly run race. He draws poorly outside the front row and will likely be a long way back in the run but if the race is run to suit he should be very hard to hold out late. PUNTERS JEWEL (5) got back and was running on reasonably late into fourth there not beaten far. He is likely to be shuffled back again in this race from an awkward draw and can be running on late again. NEXT TO ME (6) was a good winner three starts ago running over the top late to beat RACANA (4) at this track and trip. He ran well again two starts ago finishing second to Fire And Passion. SELECTIONS: RACANA (4), COSMIC FLYER (7), PUNTERS JEWEL (5), NEXT TO ME (6) SUGGESTED BET: COSMIC FLYER (7) to win.

BOLD PERSONALITY (4) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was working through the line nicely. She looks likely to settle close again in this race from a good draw and should be hard to beat. POCKET BOOK (1) draws well in this race and can lead before having options from there. Generally she has been best suited in races when driven with a sit and she may be driven that way again in this race. MAYWYNS KAREN (3) settled close to the speed last time out after working forward at the start and was running on well late into third. She draws well in this race and with the right run can figure in the finish again. BEACH MAGIC (6) secured a good run on the pegs last time out and was able to run second there behind Major Slip Up. He draws awkwardly outside the front row but with the right run can figure in the finish again. SELECTIONS: BOLD PERSONALITY (4), POCKET BOOK (1), MAYWYNS KAREN (3), BEACH MAGIC (6) SUGGESTED BET: BOLD PERSONALITY (4) to win.

HARRY KANE (1) has gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead early in this race. He was able to work to the lead last time out and was able to take them all the way proving too good for Kingsbury. The step up in trip doesn’t look ideal but he is seemingly getting better each run. LONGSHOT (12) has been very impressive in recent outings including last time out when running a good third having been forced to do the work outside the leader. He draws poorly outside the back row in this race but can be put into the race at some stage and should run well again. SHE MAYBE BETTOR (6) secured a good run on the pegs off the speed last time out at this track and trip and was running on nicely into second late. She should secure a good run off the speed again in this race and can be running on late. SHEZ A WARRIOR (3) got back in the run last time out at Redcliffe and was running on late there into third behind The Tiger Army. She should get a good run in this race again and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: HARRY KANE (1), LONGSHOT (12), SHE MAYBE BETTOR (6), SHEZ A WARRIOR (3) SUGGESTED BET: HARRY KANE (1) to win.

CAMERINA (5) sat outside the leader two starts ago and ran well there finishing second to Blackjack who had a more favourable run in the race. If she could press forward and find the lead at some stage she would likely be very hard to run down. BETTOR BE BOHDI (4) has good gate speed and should be able to press forward and find a prominent position. He secured a good run behind the leader last time out and wasn’t beaten far in third. BIGBASHASH (10) ran on strongly late last time out to beat Toro Loco. If the race is run to suit he should be running on strongly late. ALWAYS ADORNED (6) put in an excellent run last time out when finishing second behind Racana in fast time over the 1660. She may be forced to do the work again from a wide draw but shouldn’t be far away. SELECTIONS: CAMERINA (5), BETTOR BE BOHDI (4), BIGBASHASH (10), ALWAYS ADORNED (6) SUGGESTED BET: CAMERINA (5) to win. OVERVIEW:SUZYS DREAM (2) is in flying form, having won two of her last three starts. The run she didn’t win can be forgotten, as she was checked early. When winning last start at Shepparton, she raced in the breeze and was simply too good. She has the best sectional times in this event, but she is surrounded by horses with good gate speed, so the map could be awkward for her. OUR TINKA BELLA (8) is a mare who has had only three career starts and is yet to get it right with her manners under race conditions. She raced in the breeze last start and looked the winner before galloping in the final few strides and being relegated to third. If she trots throughout, she has a motor. CHINSKI (3) has been a bit unlucky recently, being checked at his last two starts. His runs prior were good, however. He has gate speed and experience and should be able to map well here. VAN DOREN (4) doesn’t have great numerical form, but at his best, he has nice ability. He can be slow away and is often saved for one run late. If he can slot in somewhere close enough, he will be right in this. RIPPING RONALDO (10) has a motor and can win this if he trots, but he has galloped in five of his six starts. The one time he stayed trotting, he won. BACK: SUZYS DREAM (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SUZYS DREAM (2), OUR TINKA BELLA (8), CHINSKI (3), VAN DOREN (4)

OVERVIEW:RIDE HIGH CAPTIN (2) looks to be improving with each start. Last start, he battled on well for third after enjoying a nice run. He can go well here. HEAVENLY NIKKI (9) is always competitive and finishes close in these events. It surprises me that she is still a maiden, and she is a winning chance despite the barrier. DIMITRI (3) is a first starter for Chris Romanidis. He finished second in a recent trial at Geelong behind trotter Calabasas. We will learn more about him here. GOODMORNING MIKI (1) is an interesting runner. She is yet to have things go her way under race conditions, either making mistakes with her manners or being checked by other runners. Her trial form is good, though, and she has the barrier to map positively here. With a change in luck, she can win this. SELECTIONS: RIDE HIGH CAPTIN (2), HEAVENLY NIKKI (9), DIMITRI (3), GOODMORNING MIKI (1)

OVERVIEW:TOUCH OF REALITY (1) made an eye-catching run from last during the third quarter last start before finishing second. If he had been racing on the fence, his converted last quarters would have been 27.73 and 29.23. He has been racing well, has the ace barrier and possesses the gate speed to capitalise here. SEW HOPEFULL (3) looked close to breaking through for her maiden victory last start when battling out the finish with Keayang Maricruz. She has a good turn of foot. BETTER THAN DAICOS (4) over-raced last start and tired at Mildura, so that is a run we can put a line through. The start prior, he led and finished second behind the smart Notguilty. This looks like an easier contest. THATS ME AGAIN (5) rarely puts in a bad run but has recently come up against one or two slightly better horses. She let down nicely last start and is good enough if she is close enough. Also noting DIAMOND CHIPP (6), who has good sectional times heading into this event. BACK: TOUCH OF REALITY (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TOUCH OF REALITY (1), SEW HOPEFULL (3), BETTER THAN DAICOS (4), THATS ME AGAIN (5)

OVERVIEW:OSCAROO (5) is a first starter for Fred Spiteri. He has good trial form and has appeared to be a safe trotter with a will to win. His trials have been run in slow times, so it is difficult to assess him against these trotters. However, we will learn more about him here. ROYAL LADY (1) is having her third career start for top trotting trainer Brent Lilley. She made a mistake with her manners on debut, but last start she battled on well in a field stronger than this one. Barrier one suits. DANCE WITH ROXY (2) has put it all together at her last two starts and has been eye-catching. She has good gate speed, a nice turn of foot and a good record at this track. HEMINGWAY SPECIAL (3) is a first starter for Denis Grieve. He is a full brother to My Ultimate Sunny, who looked to be a star before his career was seemingly cut short. His trials have been at Bacchus Marsh without replays, so it is difficult to gauge his ability. However, he is well bred and trained by Grieve, who is great with trotters. SELECTIONS: OSCAROO (5), ROYAL LADY (1), DANCE WITH ROXY (2), HEMINGWAY SPECIAL (3)

OVERVIEW:LORIMERMAJOR (1) finds a suitable race and barrier here to get back to his best form. He flashed home nicely from near last last start to finish second behind WHERES WOOD WOOD (8), who is drawn on his back here. WHERES WOOD WOOD (8) will be hoping LORIMERMAJOR (1) can hold the front and provide the perfect trail into the race. He is performing well and is well placed here. MONSIEUR FLAMEL (5) has a nice turn of foot, whether he is saved for one run or uses his gate speed early. The barrier makes things tricky, but he is a winning chance with some luck. SPEEDY HEALEY (4) is a consistent horse who is racing well and has the best sectional times in this field. The barrier is awkward, however. BACK: LORIMERMAJOR (1)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: LORIMERMAJOR (1), WHERES WOOD WOOD (8), MONSIEUR FLAMEL (5), SPEEDY HEALEY (4)

OVERVIEW:ANAKIN (6) is third-up here, so I expect him to be back to peak race fitness. He got fired up in the breeze last start at Kilmore but still battled on well for fourth. The barrier is awkward, but he is a smart type. FOREGONE CONCLUSION (7) got too far back last start but let down reasonably well in a race stronger than this one. He is a versatile, experienced horse who can make his own luck at this grade. BEAU BECA (3) produced an improved run last start, finishing a nice third after flashing home from three-back on the fence. If he gets a good run here, he is right in this. FOUR EVER A STAR (2) returned to the winners’ circle last start after building her fitness following a long time on the sidelines. She now has that winning confidence back. Also respecting JUSTLIKEDAVE (4) if he can find a good position in the race. BACK: ANAKIN (6)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ANAKIN (6), FOREGONE CONCLUSION (7), BEAU BECA (3), FOUR EVER A STAR (2)

OVERVIEW:TOMMYS LOOKOUT (2) has not been racing at his best, which is reflected in his numerical form. However, he has also had some bad luck and drawn poor barriers. He does have the gate speed, and if he can find the fence here, he is a threat. RIDDLEMETHIS (7) is in flying form this preparation. First-up, he stormed home from last to finish second. Last start, he did all the work and was simply too good. The barrier is a concern, as he will need to make his own luck, but he is racing well enough to win. ARE WEASLEY (5) rarely puts in a bad run, but he is first-up here, which could leave him vulnerable. OPERTSER (4) and MIKI MARK (6) are both racing well but will need to overcome tricky barriers. SELECTIONS: TOMMYS LOOKOUT (2), RIDDLEMETHIS (7), ARE WEASLEY (5), OPERTSER (4)

OVERVIEW:KRAKEY (7) let down nicely last start but was simply too far back. He is racing well, and this looks like a suitable race for him despite the tricky barrier. He has the best sectional times in this event. TEX GOES BANG (6) and HOME AND DRY (5) have similar form lines heading into this event. Both are horses who consistently run well when they get some luck. GLENLINE (8) is a great swooper. When saved for one run, he is always rattling home late. He is the only horse on the back row, so he will have options to stay or leave the fence. BACK: KRAKEY (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KRAKEY (7), TEX GOES BANG (6), HOME AND DRY (5), GLENLINE (8)

OVERVIEW:BETTORLEFTALONE (4) and REFUSAL (3) are two exciting new additions to the Alex Ashwood stable from New South Wales. BETTORLEFTALONE (4) comes out of the Victoria Derby. He tired in the Final after a tough run in a brilliant field, but he finished a good fourth in his heat, defeating some talented horses. He looks well placed here. REFUSAL (3) is a classy mare who rarely puts in a bad run. However, she may be vulnerable first-up since June. WITH IN REASON (7) has a brilliant turn of foot, which he showed in early August when he looped the field to win impressively at Melton. If there is speed on early here, he will be ready to strike late. EMILY VINCENT (2) may find this difficult, but she should be able to map well and has a nice turn of foot. She also has great gate speed if connections choose to use it. SELECTIONS: BETTORLEFTALONE (4), REFUSAL (3), WITH IN REASON (7), EMILY VINCENT (2) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

DARLINGTON (5) probably has the most ability in this race but she can do things wrong. If she can pace smoothly and do everything right she will be hard to beat today. MAJOR APDAL (2) has also shown signs of ability and he looks like a major chance today in a weaker race compared to what he has been up against. TIGER MUMFF (4) and WHITE STAR CHLOE (1) are also chances.

SWEET NICKY (8) has her first South Australian start today. She won a trial at Globe Derby last week and ran a last mile of 2.00.9. Her stable and her driver must be respected in this sort of race. NORMANS GIRL (1) will love the inside draw. She gets a big chance to win a race today. WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (2) and MY ULTIMATE BANJO (3) are also chances.

NAROBI (5) was a winner four starts back at Globe Derby and her recent runs in The Radiant series was very impressive. She is a big chance today in an easier race. FE FE ON FIRE (6) took out The Radiant Consolation last start here at Port Pirie where she defeated REACH THE PEAK by 1.3 metres. She is a strong chance again today. WATCHMEDAZZLE (3) is a good chance of finding the lead and running a strong race out in front. MISTER QUIRK (4) looks the next best.

MISS NASHVILLE (9) has won her first three career starts. She is a serious filly with a strong turn of foot. It’s hard to see her getting beat today if she is anywhere near her best. OPEN THE GATES (6) looks like the main danger. It may pay to watch her market moves first up from a spell. BUSTNLOOSE (2) and PLATINUM DANCER (3) look the next best.

LINCS POOR BOY (2) looks like the early leader here. His recent form hasn’t been great but he can bounce back today in a race where it’s hard to see him not leading. REACH THE PEAK (6) ran second last start in The Radiant Consolation. Today is a tough draw for him but if he can get a quiet run then she should be charging home late. MY ULTIMATE SKEETA (8) and SPORTSFLIGHT (4) are also chances.

WHENIMREADY (8) will need some luck from the second row but he has won his last two starts and he brings the best form into this race. He will be hard to beat. OHSO KINKY (4), ROLL WITH MUSTARD (7) and TEDDY SANDEL (9) are also chances. Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:TOBYS SHOUT (8) could be the beneficiary of some good early speed off the front row here, with a few likely to want the top spot over the short trip. At best, he can map behind the leader, but even if he’s three pegs, he can strike from there. He was a good winner at Wagga two back and backed that up from a bad draw last time when doing plenty of work. If he gets the luck, he’ll be charging late. ALTA BAYAMO (3) is a different horse when he can lead, but he’s going to have to really burn to cross those drawn inside. He’s a rocks-or-diamonds play but would be easy to find on top if there were more certainty with the map. MUSSEL SHOALS (2) is a quick beginner first up from a break off one trial. She’s well placed with the mares’ allowance, and despite having fitness to come, her likely map over the short trip makes her an attractive option. CRESCO THREEPEAT (9) could be an improver on recent form if there is a good early tempo. He’s a grinding type who will keep coming if the leaders get tired. EAGLE MAJOR (10) and TRYX VIXEN (11) have bad draws to overcome but could be kept safe if you want some extra insurance for the Early Quaddie. SELECTIONS:TOBYS SHOUT (8), ALTA BAYAMO (3), MUSSEL SHOALS (2), CRESCO THREEPEAT (9)

OVERVIEW:ALDEBARAN DENBAY (7) has been near faultless in four runs for new trainer Brooke McPherson, winning three straight before his 2nd at Menangle last time, when he was a well-supported favourite and still ran well. This doesn’t look any more challenging than what he’s been taking on, and despite drawing wide, he can press forward. There’s no reason he can’t go on with it. THE CHOOK (8) is a little awkwardly drawn, but her recent form is hard to ignore at this level. She has a good strike rate at this track, and if the breaks come, she will be in the finish. KALARNEY PRINCE (2) has been racing up in class and drops back to the level that saw him a winner three runs back. He should map softly, and a repeat of that previous win would be a good benchmark to go close. ALDEBARAN MARCUS (6) is backing up from Sunday and may be in a sticky position map-wise, but if things work out, he has claims. BACK: ALDEBARAN DENBAY (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALDEBARAN DENBAY (7), THE CHOOK (8), KALARNEY PRINCE (2), ALDEBARAN MARCUS (6)

OVERVIEW:MYNAMEISRUBY (5) runs her best races for James Herbertson and finds a nice map here, where she looks likely to cross those drawn inside comfortably and then have options thereafter, either holding the lead depending on the pressure or taking the right cover. The middle section should be slow, so she should have enough air in the lungs to close off. GOODTIME MAE (6) may try to wrestle away the lead, as she did three runs back when failing as an odds-on favourite. This looks easier, so with the right map, she is capable of improvement. JOEYS HANGOVER (11) won that race, but on that occasion, he drew more favourably. He’s still well placed on the ratings scale and can do his best work late with enough tempo. SALSBOY (10) is a veteran who’s been racing okay but performs better when he’s able to race closer to the speed. Don’t dismiss him. FAKE CULLECTION (7) may be sent forward from the draw, but I’m not sure how that works out. She’s going well enough, so despite needing luck, she should be in calculations. SELECTIONS:MYNAMEISRUBY (5), GOODTIME MAE (6), JOEYS HANGOVER (11), SALSBOY (10)

OVERVIEW: A real mix of ages and form lines here, with several smart 2yos taking on more experienced types. DELIZIOSO (4) is a smart 3yo filly who drops in class coming out of the Victoria Oaks, where she ran a gutsy 5th. She’s third up here after bumping into some good ones in her first two outings, and she may need some luck with the map, but she’s a gutsy type who will give her all. BETTORBUST (5) has recorded both his wins at Mildura, but they’ve been full of merit, showing good versatility. Last time, he had to sustain a long run from the back and was too good. It will be fascinating to see how he shapes up here, as he looks to have ability. ASHANTE WARRIOR (2) was chasing what looks to be a smart one when 2nd at Melton last start, and that followed a good win at Kilmore when able to lead. He’s in the mix. MAJOR ORION (3) is racing well without much luck and now has a more positive draw to race forward. He’s deserving of another win, if not here then soon. ATOMIK GO ANNA (10) is a fascinating runner, being a 2yo filly who’s been taking on the best of her age and sex in NSW. It’s just hard to line her up with the others from this draw over the short trip. SELECTIONS:DELIZIOSO (4), BETTORBUST (5), MAJOR ORION (3), ASHANTE WARRIOR (2)

OVERVIEW:TALISKER SKIPPER (7) looks well served with the claim and mares’ allowance and, as an O/D runner, is the sole runner off the back row with options. Her recent form has been quite good, winning five runs back at Melton and not finishing far away since. If the polemarker can lead, there’s every chance she could get a perfect spot behind it. OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (1) was able to lead at Cranbourne from the pole two runs back, where he ran a good 2nd, and prior to that led all the way at Wagga. If he finds the top spot, he will take plenty of running down. OLLY ODD POTTS (2) has been racing more consistently of late and was rewarded with a win at Cranbourne last time, beating a weaker field when able to lead. LATHER ME UP (5) is a 2yo filly who switches to the smart Ashwood barn. She has gate speed, and although her form doesn’t really stack up, monitor any betting moves for a potential spike on what she’s been producing. Of the rest, ZEUSS (3) can improve now he’s had more time with the new stable, and BERYLS BOOTS (4) has been racing well despite finding a stronger field here. Both are worth throwing into the Quaddie. BACK: TALISKER SKIPPER (7) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS:TALISKER SKIPPER (7), OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (1), OLLY ODD POTTS (2), LATHER ME UP (5)

OVERVIEW:OUR SWEET JEANNIE (1) returns to her favourite track and grade after racing against the elite 3yos. She has early gate speed, but she will have company from out wide to get the map she wants. She’s won three of five starts here at Shepparton, and I’m backing the class drop to see her return to winning form. MASON JOLIE (7) is another who drops in grade but has been racing gamely against some smart types. He can finish his races off well but will need the right tempo in a small field. YAPPER (3) gets Herbertson and can be driven urgently, with speed inside and outside him, to see how the map works out. He’s not had much luck in his last few, so expect him to improve on his numerical form. IM DUSTEE (2) just missed last week, and if he can hunt up well enough to follow the top pick, he will be closing late. BACK: OUR SWEET JEANNIE (1) – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS:OUR SWEET JEANNIE (1), MASON JOLIE (7), YAPPER (3), IM DUSTEE (2)

OVERVIEW:MILLIES BOY (6) is a 2yo gelding having her first start and has trialled well for this, going across the line together with a stablemate who won last week, providing a good form reference. The stable is flying, which is another layer of confidence in a race that requires a bit of guesswork. OZZIE BULL (8) has been a lot better in his last few, and to be fair, he’s been racing at a much better level than this in most of his six starts. The draw isn’t ideal, but he’s on the improve. IM A ROCKSTAR (2) met with market support at longer odds last week in what looked a challenging race on paper, but she ran well, and a repeat of that performance has her in the mix. JASPER JAY (5) loomed up to do something and just peaked on his run first up to finish 3rd here last week. He showed decent ability last preparation, so he can go on with it. KELLYS COMMOTION (4) has her first run for the new stable after arriving from NSW, but I wasn’t rapt with the trial. Monitor betting moves and throw her into the Quaddie, even though there are question marks. SELECTIONS:MILLIES BOY (6), OZZIE BULL (8), IM A ROCKSTAR (2), JASPER JAY (5)

OVERVIEW:YELLA (3) has been my top pick in his past three runs, and even though he hasn’t saluted, he’s been quite good from bad draws and finding the line well.
